tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// dpal snar thang pa'i mngon rtogs brgya rtsa bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di 'phral du mkho ba'i bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam gyi lha'i mngon rtogs dang*/ de'i rjes gnang gi phyag bzhes/ gzhan yang 'phral du mkho ba'i las kha tshar gyi rim pa rnams brjod par bya ste/ 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad/ rdo rje dril bu/ re khā'i pad 'dab bam/ me tog gi tshom bu/ gtor ma rnams tshags su chud par byas nas/ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ shākya thub pa sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon pa mnyam gzhag na bza' chos gos dmar po gsol bar gyur par bsam/ de'i thugs kar ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ dmar ser las 'od 'phros te/ 'og min nas ye shes pa rang 'dra ba spyan drangs te mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la gsol ba btab nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥyis gnyis su med par bstims la/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ bsams te/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// rten 'brel gyi gzungs chu byed na yang bdag bskyed 'dis mdun bskyed kyi chu snod du a las zla ba'i steng du rten 'brel snying po'i yig 'bru las thub pa chen po bskyed de ye shes pa bstims nas snying po bzlas pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bzhu bar bsams la chus khrus la sogs pa bya'o// ༈ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di la gnyis te/ spyi gtsug dang*/ maṇ+ḍal la brten te bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang la/ bdag gi spyi bor nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma re cha lugs bla mar 'dug kyang ngo bo sangs rgyas dngos su bzhugs par bsam mo// de'i thugs kar hrīḥdakar po gcig bsam/

de las 'od zer lan gsum spro gsung*/ dang po 'phros pas bla ma brgyud pa mas rim nas jo bo man chad dam/ shes na sangs rgyas la thug pa'i bar spyan drangs te bla ma de nyid la thim pas bla ma brgyud pa thams cad 'dus pa'i skur bsam mo// gnyis pa 'phros pas rang gi bla ma chos 'brel yod tshad thams cad spyan drangs nas bla ma de nyid la thim pas bla ma thams cad 'dus pa'i skur bsam mo// gsum pa 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas bla ma'i thugs kar thim pas sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i skur bsams la/ skabs 'dir phyag dang mchod pa dbul bar bya'o// gsol ba gdab pa ni 'di skad ces brjod do// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyi dang nang gi bar chad thams cad bsal du gsol/ byang chub kyi sems nyams pa med pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ting nge 'dzin nyams pa med pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ shes rab nyams pa med pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la dad cing gus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags mtha' dag gi snod du rung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ brtson 'grus dpag tu med pa rtsom nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes lan gsum brjod do// gnyis pa maṇ+ḍal la brten pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal gyi lte bar pad zla'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥdakar po las 'od zer lan gsum 'phros pas sngar bzhin du spyan drangs la gsol ba gdab bo/

/rjes la bla ma mi dmigs par bsam/ bsngo ba dang bzod gsol dang mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab pa kha bskang bas chog gsung ngo*/ /'di 'jigs pa dang 'chi khar dran na mi dang mi ma yin pa dang ngan song las skyob nges pa yin gsung*/ 'di gal che bas rab kyis dus rtag tu dang*/ 'bring gis dus gsum dang*/ tha ma yang zhag re la thun re cis kyang bsam dgos gsung ngo*// chu mig pa dang*/ mu rin chen snying po/ sman pa dang*/ sgom nag dang*/ rin chen sgang pa ku mā ka ra/ bzhi bag re tsam mi mthun pa las/ 'di mnyam pa med pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin chen sgang pa'i zhal nas byung ba yin gsung ngo*// bla ma'i rnal 'byor rdzogs so/// / ༈ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bo rje/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug dgon pa ba/ spyan snga rin po che/ bya yul ba/ dgyer sgom chen po/ mnyam med sangs rgyas dbon/ dpal ldan gro mo che/ kun mkhyen mchims so// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rang khams ma bde ba'i dus su bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rang tha mal pa lta bur 'dug ste/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du tshogs gsag sgrib pa sbyang*/ bar chad bsal ba'i don du bla ma la gsol ba gdab snyam du bsams la/ de nas rang yi dam gyi lha gang yin du gyur par bsam/ de'i spyi bo na spyi bo la ma rig tsam du lam̐ ser po/ de yongs su gyur pa las gser gyi sa gzhi khru gang zlum po gcig tu gyur par bsam/ de'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de skyil krung du bzhugs par bsam/ rang rten gang yin pa'i rten de nyid gser gyi sa gzhi'i mtha' ma na phar la g.yas skor du bskor ba dal gyis byed pa/ 'phral la bla ma la me tog 'thor zhing skor ba byed par bsams la/ ngag tu gsol 'debs kyi tshig 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ oṃ na mo gu ru badz+ra sid+dhi hūm̐/

zhes brjod cing skor ba byed pas de mi dmigs pa gsal bar byas la sngags 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad dam stong rtsa brgyad du bzla'o// 'di ni shin tu zab pa yin/ 'di ni yi dam gyi lha gzung ba'i dbang skal yin gsung*/ skyer sgang pa las brgyud pa'i man ngag*// ༈ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i 'das mchod byed pa ni don shin tu che ba yin te/ mdor bsags las/ skye bo phal pa stong phrag brgya// bram ze gtsang ma gcig dang sbyar// bram ze gtsang ma stong phrag brgya// 'khor los sgyur ba gcig dang sbyar// 'khor los sgyur ba stong phrag brgya// ye shes thob pa gcig dang sbyar// ye shes thob pa stong phrag brgya// dgra bcom gcig dang sbyar bar bya// dgra bcom stong phrag brgya dag ni// bla ma gcig dang sbyar bar bya// zhes gsungs la// rgyud kha gsang 'dus dang rnam snang sgyu drwa las/ cig las/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa byas pa bas bla ma'i ba spu'i bu ga gcig la snum thigs pa gcig gsol ba bsod nams che/ zhes gsungs pa yod gsung*/ de yang dge bshes chen po sha ra ba pa'i zhal nas/ 'das mchod byas pa la phan yon rnam pa drug yod de/ bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par 'gyur ba dang*/ bla ma la brten pa'i sdig sgrib 'byang bar 'gyur ba dang*/ rang gis bsod nams rgya chen po thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ skye ba phyi ma la bla ma rnams dang mjal bar 'gyur ba dang*/ bla ma rnams kyi gdul byar 'gyur ba dang*/ 'khor ba myur du zad pa'i phan yon yod do// de ji ltar byed na rjes su dran pa drug gi sgo nas byed de/ bla ma zhal bzhugs pa'i dus kyi sku'i rnam pa rjes su dran pa dang*/ dang po rab tu byung nas bslab pa gsum la nan tan mdzad cing lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i thugs kyi yon tan rjes su dran pa dang*/ jo bo chen po lha gcig gi bka' brgyud skyes bu chen po'i chos lugs shing rta chen po'i srol gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam thar rjes su dran pa dang*/

rang gi bde skyid la sogs pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bla ma las byung ba yin snyam du bka' drin rjes su dran pa dang*/ chos bsam du btub pa la sogs pa smon du rung ba thams cad bla ma'i byin rlabs yin snyam du byin rlabs rjes su dran pa dang*/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas tha dad med par mos shing yid la byed pa dad pa rjes su dran pa'o// zhes gsungs so// des nas bla mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus su dran pa drug gi sgo nas/ dkon mchog la mchod pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur la ci 'byor byas la/ bla ma la dad pa dang gus pa chen pos sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dpang du bzhugs par mos pa bya ste/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ dge 'dun bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag rnams kyis dkon mchog la mchod pa phul ba dang*/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bgyis pa dang*/ 'byung po la gtor ma btang ba dang*/ bsrung sdom dang*/ bzlas brjod dang*/ thos bsam dang*/ sgom sgrub la sogs pa bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs ci bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag thams cad gcig tu bsdus shing bzlums te bsdams nas bdag cag gi bla ma yang dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge slong byang chub sems dpa' 'di zhes bya ba yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// phul bas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi thugs dgongs khyad par can rnams gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig sa dang lam gyi rim pa'i spang bya dang gegs dang sgrib par gyur pa ci mchis pa thams cad ni byang zhing dag par gyur cig lam lnga sa bcu rim gyis bgrod nas bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi don du myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig bdag cag rnams la yang bla ma la brten pa'i nyes pa sku la bsdos pa/

rin la bsnyegs pa/ gsung ngag bcag pa/ nyes pa gtam du brjod pa/ thugs tshod bzung ba/ thugs sun phyung ba la sogs pa nyes pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig tshe rabs thams cad du yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal bar gyur cig mjal nas kyang mnyes pa byed par gyur cig mi mnyes pa skad cig kyang byed par ma gyur cig tshe rabs thams cad du dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi thugs kyis 'dzin par gyur cig gzung du btub par gyur cig gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pas skyong bar gyur cig bskyang du btub par gyur cig tshe rabs thams cad du dge ba'i bshes gnyen mi brjed pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur cig dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam thar dri ma med pa la longs spyod par gyur cig mthar sems can thams cad kyi don du myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig bla ma'i gsung bzhin nam mkha' grags kyis bsdebs pa'o// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi tshul bzung nas byang chub sems dpa'i phrin las mdzad pa gnas brtan chen po bcu drug la gsol ba 'debs par 'dod pas/ khrus dang gtsang sbra dang ldan par byas te/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa byas la/ me tog gi tshom bu dgod/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang gnas brtan chen po bcu drug la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ lag mthil ltar mnyam rin chen rgyan gyis spras// ljon shing chu mtshos brgyan pa'i sa gzhi'i dbus// rin chen las grub gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa// pad+ma nyi zlas brgyan pa'i gdan steng du// thugs rjes rtsod pa'i dus kyi gdul bya rnams// rnam grol lam la 'god mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon// thub pa mchog dang gnas brtan chen po rnams// 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*// shes rab me 'bar nyon mongs mtsho skems shing*// rnam grol bsod nams zhing du bka' sdod pa// phyogs bcu'i nyan thos dge 'dun bzhugs so 'tshal// yon sbyor mchod pa'i gnas su spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// 'gro ba'i mgon po shākya seng ge yis// sangs rgyas bstan pa gang gi phyag tu bzhag

/gsung rab rin chen sgrom gyi kha 'byed pa// chos skyong dgra bcom chen po bzhugs so 'tshal// dam chos spel ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// yan lag 'byung dang ma pham nags na gnas// dus ldan rdo rje mo'i bu bzang po dang*// gser be'u bha ra dh+wa dza gser can dang*// 'phags pa ba ku la dang sgra gcan 'dzin// lam phran bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len// lam brtan klu'i sde sbed byed mi phyed pa// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// spangs dang ye shes phun tshogs sangs rgyas kyang*// gdul bya'i dbang gis nyan thos tshul 'dzin pa// khyad par can gyi phrin las chos skyong ba// gnas brtan bcu drug 'dir byon gdan la bzhugs// bde gshegs bka' lung gtsor mdzad bstan pa bsrung*// rang don dor nas 'khor ba'i nags tshal du// gzhan don lhur mdzad gnas brtan bcu drug po// dam bcas thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs// dge bsnyen skyabs gsol bden pa'i tshig nyan pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs 'bring mchis so 'tshal// bsod nams rin chen gling du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte ba la bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu/ phyag g.yas pa sa gnon/ g.yon pa mnyam gzhag rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ shar gyi pad 'dab bzhi la gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan 'dzin phyag g.yas na rin po che'i prog zhu bsnams pa dang*/ gnas brtan chen po lam phran brtan/ phyag gnyis mnyam par gzhag pa dang*/ gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len phyag g.yas na glegs bam/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na lhung bzed bsnams pa dang*/

gnas brtan chen po lam brtan phyag g.yas na glegs bam/ g.yon chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'o// lho'i pad 'dab bzhi la gnas brtan chen po klu'i sde phyag g.yas bum pa/ g.yon 'khar gsil bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po sbed byed phyag na glegs bam bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po mi phyed pa phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i dbus na spos phor bsnams pa/ mchan khung g.yon na rnga yab bsnams pa'o// nub kyi pad 'dab bzhi la/ gnas brtan chen po ma pham pa phyag gnyis mnyam par gzhag pa/ gnas brtan chen po nags na gnas phyag g.yas zhi ba'i sdigs mdzub/ g.yon rnga yab bsnams pa'o// gnas brtan chen po dus ldan phyag na gser gyi rna kor bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po rdo rje mo'i bu phyag g.yas zhi ba'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ g.yon rnga yab bsnams pa'o// byang gi pad 'dab bzhi la/ gnas brtan chen po bzang po phyag g.yas chos 'chad/ g.yon mnyam par gzhag pa/ gnas brtan chen po gser be'u phyag gnyis rin po che'i zhags pa bsnams pa'o// gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza gser can phyag gnyis mnyam par gzhag pa/ gnas brtan chen po ba ku la phyag na ne'u le bsnams pa'o// sgo bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen chen po dharma ta phyag na rnga yab dang bum pa bsnams pa/ ral pa'i thod bcings pa/ sde snod kyi glegs bam mang po khur ba/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs pa/ dar gyi na bza' lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ pus mo brdzes pa/ pus mo g.yas pa las stag gi tshogs sprul pa/ dge bsnyen gyi tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs shing*/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ dgra bcom pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa bzhugs par bsam zhing*/

de rnams kyi thugs dgongs gcig pas byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i zhabs la dus rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa dam pa'i chos skyong zhing lha mi kun gyi bsod nams kyi dpal zhing du de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas bka' bsgos te/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'jig rten na mngon sum du bzhugs shing*/ bka' lung gi rjes su bsgrub pa/ 'phags pa'i tshig nges par zhal gyis bzhes pa/ gangs ri chen po ti se la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung*/ 'khor dgra bcom pa stong sum brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// 'di man gong dang 'gre'o// drang srong ri'i shel nags na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po ma pham pa 'khor dgra bcom lnga brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /de'i nags kyi ngogs lo ma bdun pa zhes bya ba'i ri phug na/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po nags na gnas 'khor dgra bcom pa stong bzhi brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /zangs gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po dus ldan 'khor dgra bcom pa stong chig brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /siṅga la'i gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po rdo rje mo'i bu 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈

/chu bo ya mu na'i gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bzang po 'khor dgra bcom pa stong nyis brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /kha che'i yul na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po gser be'u 'khor dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /nub kyi ba glang spyod na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza gser can 'khor dgra bcom pa bdun brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /byang gi sgra mi snyan na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po ba ku la 'khor dgra bcom pa dgu brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /pri yaṃ ku'i gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan 'dzin 'khor dgra bcom pa stong dang chig brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /bya rgod phung po'i ri la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po lam phran brtan 'khor dgra bcom pa stong drug brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /shar gyi lus 'phags gling na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /lha'i gnas sum cu rtsa gsum na 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po lam brtan 'khor dgra bcom pa dgu brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /ri'i rgyal po ngos yangs la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po klu'i sde 'khor dgra bcom pa stong nyis brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /ri'i rgyal po bi hu lar 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po sbed byed 'khor dgra bcom pa stong bzhi brgyas bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/

༈ /gangs can ri'i rgyal po la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po mi phyed pa 'khor dgra bcom pa stong gis bskor te bzhugs pa'i zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /'phags pa'i dge bsnyen chen po dharma ta 'khor dge bsnyen gyi tshogs dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi zhabs la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba gdab/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes mang du bzla'o// bstod pa bya/ mchod pa dang gtor ma dbul/ gsol gdab/ de nas/ sangs rgyas sprul pa dgra bcom 'phags pa'i tshogs// 'gro ba'i don du bstan pa skyong mdzad pa// dkon mchog gsum dngos gnas brtan bcu drug gis// bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs// thugs rje'i bdag nyid gnas brtan bcu drug gi// 'khor tshogs srid mtsho las brgal nyon mongs med// khri dang drug stong bzhi brgya'i tshogs rnams kyi// bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs// sems can kun gyi bsod gyur dgra bcom pa// rig dang zhabs ldan skye dgu'i sbyin gnas che// 'phags pa'i gang zag chen po khyed rnams kyis// bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba gdab/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis ni// phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa 'phel gyur cing*// sdug bsngal kun 'byung ma lus rab spangs nas// srid pa'i rgya mtsho myur du skem par shog /bsod nams rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs gyur cing*// ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par dag gyur te// yon tan rgya mtsho ma lus kun rdzogs nas// 'jig rten kun las khyad par 'phags par shog /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin dus gsum rgyal ba yi// phrin las bsgrub cing yon tan rnam dbyer med// skal ba mnyam pa'i gdul bya smin mdzad pa'i// mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog

/dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje yis// nyan thos tshul du srid pa ji srid bar// bstan pa skyong zhing 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// gnas brtan chen po rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos 'di jo bo rje lha gcig nyid kyi gdams pa yin/ jo bo bod du byon pa'i dus su phyag phyi ba paṇ+ḍi ta gsum byon pa'i nang nas sems tsam rnam rdzun gyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta gcig la rngog byang chub 'byung gnas kyi zhus/ de la dge bshes chen po po to bas zhus/ de la dge bshes chen po sha ra bas zhus/ de la dge bshes 'chad kha bas zhus/ de la dge bshes se skyil bas zhus/ de la dge bshes lha

'od zer bla ma spyil bas zhus/ de la dge bshes dre'u tshul khrims 'od zer lhas pas zhus/ de la bla ma dge rgan lhas ba ma ṇi hūm̐ 'bar/ ba'i bshes gnyen tshul khrims kyi rgyun dang ldan zhing snyan pa'i 'od zer 'bar bas phyogs bcur khyab pas zhus/ de la kho bos zhus/ bla ma'i zhal gyi gdams pa dge slong nam mkha' grags kyis bsdebs pa'o// bla ma'i zhal nas 'di'i bsnyen pa'i tshad khri tsho gsum yin gsungs/ 'di'i sgrub thabs dang yer pa'i ras bris bcu bdun klu mes 'grom chung zhes pas rgya yul nas spyan drangs pa yin gsungs so// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga gcig bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas sha khrag gi lus dang sdig sgrib dag nas sems bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po sprul pa'i sku'i cha lugs can/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas pa sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ na bza' chos gos dmar po gsol pa gcig tu gyur par bsam/ de'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga bsam/ de las 'od 'phros te rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs la/ yid kyis phyag dang mchod pa bya/ gsol ba gdab/ dzaḥzhes brjod pas spyi bor byon/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas thim par gyur/ bam̐ zhes brjod pas dbyer med du gyur/ hoḥzhes brjod pas dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de nas spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga bsam/ de nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ la sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs la klog pa'i tshul du'am/ zhal nas 'thon te lte ba nas zhugs nas 'khor bar dmigs la bzla/ mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab par bya'o// mi 'khrugs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa bla ma'i zhal

zhang ston pa nas byon pa ltar bkod pa'o// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje chen po bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang ste/ snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi nang du pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar po gcig bsgoms te/ de las 'od 'phros pas lus kyi sha khrag dang sems kyi sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs nas 'od phung du bsgom/ de yongs su gyur pa las thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sku mdog dkar po/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pa na nor bu chu shel gyi phreng ba dkar po bsnams pa/ g.yon gnyis pa na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mtshon pa'i pad+ma dkar po kha 'bus pa rgyas pa/ sdong bu gsum rtsa ba gcig las gyes pa bsnams pa/ dbu rgyan/ zhabs gdub/ phyag gdub la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ ral pa'i thor cog dang ldan pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar po bsam/ de las 'od 'phros te 'og min nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas mdun du bzhugs pa la yid kyis phyag bya/ mchod pa phul nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab nas/ dzaḥzhes brjod pas rang gi spyi bor byon/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas thim par gyur/ bam̐ zhes brjod pas dbyer med du gyur/ hoḥzhes brjod pas dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de nas spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par zla ba'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga bsams te/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ de nas thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros te 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas thugs rje chen por gyur te 'od tshur 'dus/ yang 'od 'phros nas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dag ste shel lta bur dag pa'i zhing du gyur/

de nas yang 'od 'phros te 'gro ba thugs rje chen por gyur pa dang*/ snod dag pa 'od zer gyi tshul gyis rang la bsdu/ de yang bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu byed na rang yang hrīḥl bsdu/ hrīḥyang thig le gcig tu bsdu/ de yang stong pa nyid du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid rje btsun snang la rang bzhin med pa gcig tu bsgom/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng gi hrīḥl sngags kyis bskor bar bsams te/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zhes bzla'o// spyir ni bzlas pa'i tshul gsum ste/ ye shes sems dpa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la dmigs nas bzlas pa rje khol gyi tshul du bzlas pa dang*/ rang gi g.yas rol tu spyan drangs te grogs po'i tshul du bzlas pa dang*/ ye shes sems dpa' bstims nas bzlas pa'o// thugs rje chen po'i mngon rtogs bla ma'i gsung bzhin du bsdebs pa'o// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun seng ge sgra bsgrub par 'dod pas/ khrus dang gtsang sbra'i spyod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ gnas gtsang zhing dben par stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar po bsam/ de las 'od 'phros te bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ bdun rnam dag bya/ tshad med pa bzhi byas la gshegs su gsol/ de nas oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ zhes brjod de stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po/ de'i steng du a las seng ge dkar po/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥdakar po bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas rje btsun seng ge sgrar gyur/ 'od zer tshur 'dus te hrīḥl thim pas hrīḥyongs su gyur te rje btsun seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po/ zhabs phyed krung du bzhugs pa/ pus mo g.yas krong nge ba'i steng na phyag g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga phral te kha sbubs pa'i phyag gi nang du gzigs pa/

pus mo g.yon pa zla ba la cung zad ma 'byar ba'i bar nas bzung ste/ g.yas pa krong nge ba'i ngos su dar dmar po pus dkris byas pa'i sna gnyis g.yas ngos na 'phyang ba/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ spyan gsum pa/ rgyan med cing sku sha skem pa dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ rgyal po rol pa'i 'gying bag gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yon gyi mtheb mdzub kyi zhags mig nas pad+ma'i lcug ma skyes te gnyis su gyes pa'i ring ba ngos kyi pad+ma la ral gri 'bar ba yod pa/ nye ba'i pad+ma'i steng na me tog dri zhim po sna tshogs pas bkang ba'i thod pa dkar po gnas pa/ g.yas logs kyi sku'i thad kar ma reg pa'i tri shū la ljang gu la sbrul dkar po kha nas khrag 'dzag pas dkris te kha tshur blta ba/ ras kyi skud pa nyis sgril mdud pa 'ga' yod pa/ dpung pa g.yas kyi 'og g.yon steng du byas pa'i tshangs skud dang ldan par bsgom mo// de nas thugs kar pad zla'i steng na gnas pa'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ yid kyis phyag dang mchod pa phul ba gsol ba gdab/ dzaḥzhes brjod pas spyi bor byon/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas thim par gyur/ bam̐ zhes brjod pas dbyer med du gyur/ hoḥzhes brjod pas dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de nas spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ bsam/ de nas hrīḥlas 'od 'phros te rigs lnga spyan drangs te dbang bskur ba'i chu'i thigs pa spyi bor lud pa las snang ba mtha' yas su gyur par bsams te/ de nas hrīḥl sngags kyis bskor bar bsams te/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsingha nā da hūm̐ zhes bzla'o// bzlas pas skyo na ye shes sems dpa' phyung ste mdun du byon pa la phyag dang mchod pa phul te gsol ba btab la gshegs su gsol/ dge ba bsngo zhing mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab bo// thugs rje chen po seng ge sgra'i mngon rtogs mchims las mchims la brgyud pa'i man ngag bla ma'i gsung las byon pa ltar bsdebs pa'o// 'di ni mchims chen/

don chen blo brtan mkhan chen/ skyo/ rgyang ngo*// des bdag la'o// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang la/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar po bsam/ de'i 'od kyis sha khrag gi lus sbyangs nas/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal du gyur par bsam/ rtsa ba'i zhal dbus ma dkar ba/ g.yas ljang gu/ g.yon dmar ba/ de dag gi steng gi zhal gsum gyi dbus ma ljang gu/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ de'i steng gi zhal gsum dbus dmar/ g.yas ljang*/ g.yon dkar ba'o// de'i steng na khro zhal nag po mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du 'greng ba'o// de'i spyi bor zhi ba'i zhal dmar po gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ rgyan med cing mgul pa yan chod phyung ba'o/ phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pa na bgrang phreng*/ gsum pas yi dwags kyi skom pa sel ba/ bzhi pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o// g.yon gnyis pas pad+ma rtsa ba nas 'dzin pa/ gsum pas ril ba spyi blugs/ bzhi pas mda' gzhu 'dzin pa'o// phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pos mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung ngam/ mnyam par bzhengs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pas mdzes pa bskyed la/ ye shes sems dpa' dgug gzhug dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa dang*/ ras bzang pos sku smad g.yogs pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ ral pa dmar ser 'khyugs pas mdzes pa bsgoms la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+ya dzñā nā sā ga ra/ bai ro tsa na byū hā rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta tā ga te bh+yaḥ ar+ha te bh+yaḥ samyak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥ na maḥ.ār+ya ā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/

ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ iṭ+ṭe waṭ+ṭe/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su me wa re/ i li mi li/ tsi ti dz+wa la ma pa nā ye swā hā/ de'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas ye shes pa bdag lta bu spyan drangs la/ yid kyis phyag dang mchod pa dbul/ de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la bdag skyabs su mchi'o// ma rnams kyi don du skyabs su mchi'o// snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du rab tu skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ dzaḥbyas pas spyi bor byon/ hūm̐ byas pas bdag la thim/ baṃ byas pas dbyer med du gyur/ hoḥbyas pas dgyes par bsams la ye shes pa bstim/ de nas spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bsams la/ de nas rang gi thugs kar hrīḥdakar po gcig bsam/ de'i mthar gzungs kyis chos skor du bskor ba la dmigs te/ nangs par tho rangs brgya rtsa brgyad gdon par bya'o// dge ba bsngo zhing*/ mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab par bya'o// thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi bzlas lung mngon rtogs bla ma'i zhang zhal nas byon pa ltar dge slong nam mkha' grags kyis bsdebs pa'o// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun sgrol ma bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang ste/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du tām̐ ljang gu bsam/ de las 'od 'phros te lus kyi sha khrag sems kyi sdig sgrib dag nas 'od kyi phung por gyur/ de yongs su gyur te rang nyid rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu/ pad zla'i steng na sems dpa'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ut+pa la'i rtsa ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar bzung nas snyan gyi drung du kha bye ba/

rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ dar gyi sham thabs gsol ba/ ral pa phyed thor cog tu byas shing phyed cung zad 'phyang ba/ lang tsho dar la bab pa/ sku sha shin tu rgyas par bsgom/ de'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i steng du tām̐ ljang gu las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te mdun gyi nam mkha' la mi gang tsam du bzhugs pa la yid kyis phyag dang mchod pa byas nas gsol ba btab ste bstims pa'am/ bstod pa 'don na mdun du bzhugs pa de'i phyag skyabs sbyin mdzad pa'i 'og tu bdag dang bskyab bya thams cad tshud par bsams te/ bstod pa ci nus su gdon zhing phyag dang mchod pa phul la gsol ba gdab/ de nas dzaḥzhes brjod pas spyi bor byon/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas thim par gyur/ baṃ zhes brjod pas dbyer med du gyur/ hoḥzhes brjod pas dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de nas spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par zla ba'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga bsam/ de nas thugs ka'i tām̐ las sngags kyis bskor bar bsams te klog pa'i tshul du/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā zhes gsal ba dang*/ mi gsal ba dang*/ myur ba dang*/ bul ba la sogs pa'i skyon dang bral bar bzla'o// de yang bstod pa gtso bor byed na bstod pa mang du gdon/ bstod pa'i nus pa 'grub par byed pa sngags yin pas rgya rtsa brgyad yan chad re nges par bzla/ sngags kyi nus pa 'grub par byed pa bstod pa yang yin pas ci rigs su gdon/ bzlas pas skyo na ye shes pa phyung la gsol ba btab ste 'og min du gshegs par bya/ mjug dge ba bsngo zhing mi dmigs par bya'o// lha mo sgrol ma'i mngon par rtogs pa bla ma'i gsung las byon pa dge slong nam mkha' grags kyis bsdebs pa'o// ༈ /mnyam med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/

spyir sgrub pa po thams cad mkhyen pa thob par 'dod pa la bar chad bsrung ba shin tu gal che ste/ de yang thabs kyis bsrung ba dang*/ shes rab kyis bsrung ba'i tshul gnyis yin gsungs/ thabs kyis bsrung ba la mang du yod pa las/ jo mo la gsol ba gdab pa'i thabs bstod pa nas/ gnyis gsum bdun du mngon par brjod na// zhes pa de'i man ngag la maṇ+ḍal bzhi pas mchod pa'i phyag len bris pa 'di la rten gyi gang zag rgyud dag pa'i dge slong bzhis btab na shin tu'ang bzang ste ma grub kyang rang gcig pus kyang byas pas chog ces chu mig pa gsung gsungs/ phyag len la dbyangs dang bcas par dge slong bdun bdun gyis/ dus sku khams zhan pa dang bya ba rtsom pa la sogs pa thams cad du mdzad gsung*/ mchod pa gshom pa'i lugs ni/ spyir rten gsum 'dzom pa dang khyad par jo mo'i rten yid ches pa'i rab gnas zhugs pa gcig cis kyang dgos/ byug pa legs par byas la maṇ+ḍal re khā skor gnyis pa bzhi bris/ gsol ba gdab thabs dngos ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du byas la/ rten bzhugs pa de dag kyang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dngos yin pa dang*/ khyad par jo mo dngos yin pa'am/ dngos su bzhugs par bsams la/ dang por bla ma'i bstod pa/ sangs rgyas 'dus sku/ dkon mchog gsum la/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// sogs kyis bstod pas/ phyag gsum gsum bcu gnyis mdzad nas rten spyi la me tog re 'thor/ de nas sa la 'dug nas long dang sbyar nas/ yan lag bdun pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang bcas pa gcig bya/ mchod pa de spyi mchod du dbul/ de nas ji ltar 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ de yang thugs bstun la dad pa'i phul bskyed la/ re ltos che bar gdab bo// de nas jo mo la bstod pa gang yang rung bas bya bar gsungs kyang*/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhes bstod pa'i phyag len mdzad de/

phyag bdun byas jo mo la me tog gtor la sa la 'dug ste/ mchod pa gnyis pa phul te yan lag bdun pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang bcas pa gcig byas la/ bsgrub bya thams cad jo mo'i phyag g.yas pa'i skyabs 'og tu chud par bsams la/ bstod pa tshar gnyis gdon/ de nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ de nas yang phyag lan bdun byas nas me tog phul te mchod pa gsum pa dbul/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ bstod pa tshar gsum gsol 'debs dang bcas pa bya/ yang phyag bdun dang mchod pa bzhi pa phul la/ yan lag bdun pa byas la bstod pa tshar bdun gdon/ gsol ba lan gsum gdab bo// de nas bzod par gsol/ dge ba bsngo/ mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab bo// 'di byin rlabs shin tu che bas tshe 'di 'ba' zhig gi don yang ma yin par gtso bor thams cad mkhyen pa thob par byed pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang*/ yang dag pa'i don rgyud la skye ba'i gsol ba gdab/ de'i ched du sgrub pa la gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen tshang bar gsol ba gdab/ de yang dang yang du sa sde btsugs la gsol ba gdab/ tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ 'od srung 'di lta ste/ dper na rgya mtsho chen po na nor bu rin po che rin po che thams cad 'dus pa zhes bya ba rdo rje'i tshogs kyi nor bu rin po che'i rten yod de/ de nyi ma bdun shar nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du 'od zer byung yang rin po che de'i tshig par mi 'gyur te/ gang 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bar gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan dag na rgya mtsho chen po yod pa der nor bu rin po che de 'pho bar 'gyur te/ 'od srungs gang nor bu rin po che de rgya mtsho las gzhan du ma 'phos par 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 'tshig par 'gyur ba de ni gnas ma yin zhing go skabs med de/ de ni gnas med do// 'od srungs de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa de lta bu dag kyang dam pa'i chos yongs su zad par gyur te/

'jig rten gnas par dam pa ma yin pa'i chos bdun byung ba'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan du 'pho bar 'gyur ro// bdun gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ mu stegs can gyi gnas dang*/ sdig pa'i grogs pos yongs su zin pa dang*/ log pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ gcig la gcig 'tshe ba'i sbyor ba dang*/ lta bar gyur pa'i thibs po dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'joms par byed pa dang*/ ma thob cing mngon par ma brtags pa ste dam pa ma yin pa'i chos bdun po de dag 'jig rten gnas par byung ba de na sems can rnams snod ma yin par shes nas/ skyes bu dam pa de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan du 'pho bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas mthong ba dang*/ dam pa'i chos mnyan pa dang*/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su gsag pa dang yang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ ji ltar rgya mtsho las byung rin chen ni// rin chen bsdus zhes bya ba rab bsngags pa// bsreg pa'i bskal pa byung yang mi 'tshig ste// de yang 'jig rten 'jig tshe gzhan du 'gro// de bzhin dri ma med pa'i chos 'jig tshe// brtson 'grus mchog ldan de dag 'bad cing 'dzin// snod min 'jig rten chos min 'di rig nas// mkhas pa rgyal ba gzhan gyi drung du 'gro// zhes gsungs so// 'jig rten du dam pa ma yin pa'i sbyor ba bdun byung ba na/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams zhing gzhan du 'pho bar gsungs te/ rang cag de rnams kyi rjes su 'jug par gsol ba gdab/ dad pa dang brtson 'grus drag pos byas na 'grub nges so// bla ma la la'i

dar dgon pa zhal nas/ bod la thugs rje chen po/ rgya gar la jo mo sgrol ma lhar bzung na dpal che zhes grags gsung gsungs/ gur las kyang*/ nad kyis nyen la 'jig rten mgon// 'jigs pa la ni sgrol ma nyid// ces gsungs/ slob dpon klu sgrub la sogs pa/ thugs dam mdzad pa yang mang zhing bar chad las bskyabs pa'i gtam rgyud kyang shin tu mang gsung ngo*// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bos dgon pa ba/ des ka ma sher 'od pa/ des lum ye shes byang chub/ shes rab grags/ pa ba/ des chu mig pa la/ des dpal ldan gro la gnang ba yin/ des zhang ston pa/ bla ma'i gsung las byon pa ltar dge slong nam mkha' grags kyis bsdebs pa'o// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrol ma dkar mo'i tshe bsring pa'i man ngag ni/ dang por skyabs 'gro bya/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms la/ bdag gi tshe 'phel ba'i don du jo mo'i sgom bzlas bya snyam du bsams te/ rang skad cig gis jo mo sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas na pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa/ g.yon mchog sbyin pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba la skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i lang tsho rgyas pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas par bsgom/ de'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa gcig bsam/ de'i lte bar oṃ dang hā'i bar du bdag gi ā yuḥpuṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye zhes pa/ rtsibs brgyad la tā re la sogs pa brgyad dgod/ de la dmigs te yi ge rnams klog pa'i tshul du/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re bdag gi tshe 'phel bar gyur cig swā hā/ zhes bzlas par bya'o// dus rgyun du sum brgya tsam re bzla/ zlos kyi bar du smra gcad bya/ 'jog tsa na dge ba bsngo/ mi dmigs par bya'o// dge bshes spyan snga ba'i zhal nas/

'chi ba bzlog pa'i thabs khyad par can dam pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes yin/ nga rang la 'di'i byin rlabs nyams su myong bas grub gsung*/ 'chi rtags byung ba'am/ kag dang chag che ba'i dus su bzlas pa tshan che bar bya'o// zhes gsung ngo*// dge bshes spyan snga ba'i gdams pa/ dbang gis bya 'chad kha ba la zhus/ dbang la dge bshes skyer sgang pas zhus/ de la mnyam med bla mas zhus/ de la kho bos mchims zhus so// shin tu zab/ kun la med/ nyams su blangs na byin rlabs 'byung*/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i mngon par rtogs pa bla ma'i gsung las byon pa ltar dge slong nam mkha'i grags kyis bsdebs pa'o// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje gdan pa ba ri dang*// brtson 'grus seng ge don grub rgyal// kun mkhyen blo gros brtan pa yi// zhabs rdul la gtugs mngon rtogs bri// lha mo ri khrod ma bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la skyil krung gis 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod de stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dkar po bsgom/ de'i steng du a yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ de'i steng du rang gi sems/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang sgrub thabs las pam̐ du yod/ pram̐ ser po gser gyi kha dog lta bu bsgom/ de las 'od zer 'phros te 'phags pa la phog pas mchod pa phul/ sems can la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs nas lha mor gyur/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pram̐ la thim pas pram̐ yongs su gyur te rdo rje pram̐ gyis mtshan par gyur par bsgom/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus pa las rdo rje pram̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur te/ rang nyid lha mo ri khrod lo ma gyon ma sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ dbus ser ba/

zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na dgra s+t+wa/ gsum pa na mda' bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gnyis pa na shing lo'i chun po/ gsum pa na gzhu bsnams pa/ shing lo gshibs pa'i sham thabs can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sku sha skem zhing sgeg pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums/ g.yon brkyangs pas bgegs kyi rgyal po'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ me tog dmar pos thod bcings pa'i ral pa'i gseb na mi bskyod pa tshon gang bas dbur brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng na pram̐ gnas pa la sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ de la dmigs te sngags bzlas pas sngags kyi 'od zer gyis nad dang gnod pa dang bar chad thams cad thul thul bsregs par bsgom zhing*/ oṃ pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha ba ri sarba ro ga pra sha ma ne swā hā/ zhes pa bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gsum sngon du btang nas/ nangs re bzhin stong phrag re rgyun du bzlas na/ glo bur ba'i nad kyi 'jigs pa las grol bar nges so// mjug nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo/ mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab par bya'o// bla ma brgyud pa las byon pa'i gdams pa las dang po bas nyams su blang bde bar dge slong nam mkha' grags kyis bsdebs pa'o// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mo 'od zer can bsgom par 'dod pas/ khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du btang ste/ nyi ma ri rtse la ma shar ba'i sngon du kha shar phyogs su bltas la/ rkang pa g.yas pa g.yon pa'i bol steng du bzhag la byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya bcings te/ skyabs 'gro byas la/ sems can thams cad kyi dgra dang bar du gcod pa la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsal ba'i phyir lha mo 'od zer can bsgrub snyam du sems bskyed/ de nas rang gi snying gar pam̐ las pad+ma/

ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du oṃ dkar po bsam/ mtshan mo ni zla ba'o// oṃ gyi 'od kyis lus sbyangs nas 'od phung du gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po sprul pa'i sku na bza' chos gos dmar po gsol ba/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ seng ge'i khri steng na pad nyi'i gdan la skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ shing mya ngan med pa'i sdong po la sku rgyab brten par blta'o// de'i 'od kyis rang gnas sa dang 'gro ba'i sa phyogs khyab nas 'od kyi rwa ba chen po chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi mchod rten gyi dbyibs can ngo bo rdo rje'i rang bzhin can du bsam/ de'i nang du mdun du rang gi pha ma/ g.yas su zhang po la sogs pa/ g.yon du slob 'khor/ rgyab tu bran dang 'bangs/ steng du bla ma dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bzhugs par bsam mo// de nas thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du mam̐ ser po las mya ngan med kyi yal ga mam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'od zer can sku mdog ser mo sku sha skem pa tsog 'dug gis langs pa la phyogs pa/ gcer bu phyag g.yas na khab/ g.yon skud pa bsnams par bsam/ de nas sna bug g.yas pa nas rlung phyir rgyu ba dang 'grogs te byung nas/ mdun du rang la phyogs te bzhugs par bsam/ de'i mthus bgegs dang chom rkun thams cad rang gzugs kyi lhags pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i sprul pa'i khab skud sbrel ba dag gis de dag gi kha mig drubs te/ rwa ba'i phyi rol tu dor bar bsam/ de nas sprul pa de dag lha mo la bsdus la gzungs tshar gcig gdon/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ba tā li la sogs pa bdun nam nyer gcig gdon/ de nas lha mo sna bug g.yon nas rlung dang 'grogs te thugs kar zhugs pa dang*/ rang nyid 'od zer can ser mo phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon shing mya ngan med kyi yal ga la 'jus pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/

phag ser po bdun gyi khri'i steng na pad nyi la zhabs bsnol te bzhengs nas bzhugs par bsam/ de nas khri'i phag las sprul pa'i phag mang po byung nas/ rwa ba'i phyi rol gyi bgegs dang chom rkun thams cad zos shing 'dam rdzab ltar brdzis nas tshur 'dus par bsams te/ snying po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla/ de nas yang snying oṃ mā rī ts+yai swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// mtshan mo ni lha mo dkar mo'o// snga dros nyin mo dang*/ srod kyis mtshan mo'i 'jigs pa las grol lo// lha mo 'od zer gyi mngon rtogs dge slong nam mkha' grags kyi bsdebs pa'o// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mo dbyangs can ma bsgom par 'dod pas/ gnas dben par rten dang mchod pa bsham/ tho rangs khrus byas te/ stan gtsang ma bde ba la 'dug la skyabs 'gro sngon du btang ste/ rang lha'i nga rgyal du byas la/ snying gar pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du doḥdamar po bsam/ de las 'od 'phros te bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' lha mo dbyangs can ma dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs par bsam/ de dag la yid kyis phyag bya/ mchod pa ni/ me tog dbu la/ mar me spyan la/ bdug spos shangs la/ dri mchog gnas gsum du/ zhal zas zhal du/ rol mo snyan la dbul/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dge ba bsngo ba dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ lha mo dbyangs can mas lam bsgrubs pa bzhin du bdag gis kyang bsgrub snyam pa dang lam bsten pa rnams bya ste/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa dbul// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces brjod cing don bsams na tshang ngo zhes gsung*/ de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ bde ba rgyun mi chad par gyur cig snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ kun la nye ring med pa'i btang snyoms bsgom/ de nas tshogs kyi rten rnams gshegs su gsol te/ ye shes kyi tshogs gsag par bya ba'i phyir/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas phyi nang gi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ ljang gu las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bsam/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ de'i steng du rang gi sems yi ge doḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa gcig tu bsam/ de ni gsung yig 'bru las byang chub pa'o// doḥlas 'od 'phros te 'phags pa rnams la phog pas mnyes par bsam/ sems can rnams la phog pas thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te thams cad lha mo dbyangs can mar gyur par bsam/ 'od tshur 'dus te doḥl thim pas doḥyongs su gyur te pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa lte bar doḥs mtshan pa gcig bsam/ de ni thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa'o// pad+ma doḥdang bcas pa las 'od 'phros te 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus/ de yongs su gyur te/ rang nyid lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas sngo ba/ g.yon dkar ba/ dbus dmar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na gri gug gnyis pa na ral gri/ gsum sgrub thabs las/ pad+ma ral gri gri gug gsum dang po gnyis pa gsum par gsal bar bshad/ pa na pad+ma bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ gnyis pa na rin po che/ gsum pa na 'khor lo bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pas bzhengs nas bzhugs pa/

dar gyi sham thabs gsol ba/ sku las mi shes pa'i mun pa sel ba'i 'od 'phro bar bsgom/ de ni sku phyag rgya chen po las byang chub pa ste dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa'o// ye shes sems dpa' dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng du doḥdamar po bsam/ de las 'od 'phros te 'og min nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' mdun du spyan drangs la yid kyis phyag dang mchod pa dbul/ gsol ba gdab/ dzaḥzhes brjod pas spyi bor byon/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas thim par bsam/ baṃ zhes brjod pas dbyer med du gyur/ hoḥzhes brjod pas dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de nas spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par zla ba'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga bsams te sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ de nas thugs ka'i doḥlas 'od 'phros te/ rigs lnga spyan drangs la dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas/ rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis bkang ba thogs te spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus kyi phyi nang gi dri ma dang sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas lus kyi nang du bdud rtsis gang ste/ spyi bor chu'i lhag ma lud pa las rigs kyi bdag po zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog mthing ga zhal gsum/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ dbus mthing ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas na gri gug rdo rje/ ral gri/ g.yon na thod pa/ pad+ma/ 'khor lo 'am 'khor lo pad+ma bsnams pa zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pa tshon gang ba gcig tu gyur par bsam/ de nas ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' spro bsdu bya ba ni/ thugs ka'i pad zla'i steng gi doḥ la sngags kha dog dmar po mu tig dmar po'i phreng ba lta bus bskor bar bsam las dbugs dbyung ba na 'od 'phros te 'phags pa mchod cing sems can gyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ dbugs rngub pa na

'od tshur 'dus doḥl thim pas rang gi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal bar bsam/ de lta bu'i spro bsdu mang du bsgom zhing*/ des skyo na bzlas pa mang du bya ste/ oṃ bzlas pa'i skyon spangs la/ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā bar+dha ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha bar+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bud+dhi bar+dha ni swā hā/ zhes thun re la brgya'am stong la sogs pa ci rigs par bzla zhing*/ thun mtshams su ye shes sems dpa' phyung ste mchod cing gsol ba btab la gshegs su gsol te/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo zhing mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab/ gtor ma byed na oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ rtsa ba'i sngags la khā hi khā hi btags pa nyi shu rtsa gcig gis dbul/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab par bya'o// bsnyen pa skyel bar byed na smra bcad byas te mngon rtogs rgyas par bsgoms la/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa gzhung las/ ji srid 'bum phrag bar du rdzogs par gyur bya rdzogs nas las kyi rim pa'o// zhes 'byung ste/ rtsod pa'i dus su sum 'gyur du gsungs pas 'bum phrag bzhi nges par sngon du gtang nas/ sgrub pa las sbyor byed na gzhung las/ yar ngo'i tshes gcig nas ni ji srid shin tu mdzes pa'i zla ba gnas pa'i bar/ ji srid zla ba nya ba de srid nub de bzhin no legs par sbyar ba nyid/ ces 'byung bas smra bcad dang ldan pas nyin par khams dang sbyar te ci nus su bsgom bzlas bya zhing*/ mtshan mor nam mkha'i zla ba mthong ba'i sar 'dug ste zla ba nyid dam chu snod du zla ba'i gzugs brnyan shar ba la blta zhing zla ba ma nub kyi bar du bzlas pa rgyun ma chad par bya/ gal te gnyid kyis dub par gyur na nyin par cung zad ldog par bya zhing tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du bsgrub par bya'o// phan yon ni gzhung las/ de nyid nub mo thub par dka' ba'i snyan dngags mkhan du grub par 'dis 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// brgyud pa ni/

paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti kīrti la mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis zhus/ de la mchims thams cad mkhyen pas zhus/ de la don grub rgyal pos zhus/ de la bla mas zhus so// lha mo dbyangs can ma'i mngon par rtogs pa bla ma'i phyag bzhes ltar bsdebs pa'o// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang ste/ rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i snying gar pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du dhīḥdamar po bsam/ de las 'od 'phros te/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ yan lag bdun pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang bcas pa bya/ sems can la dmigs te tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ de nas tshogs kyi rten rnams rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ de nas ye shes kyi tshogs gsag pa'i phyir/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas phyi nang gi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las siṃ las seng ge sngon po ral pa dmar po nyal nas kha gyen du phyogs te gtso bo'i zhal la blta bar bsam/ de'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa bsam/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems yi ge dhīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas par bsam/ de las 'od 'phros te 'phags pa la phog pas mchod cing mnyes par gyur/ sems can la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs te 'phags pa 'jam dpal du gyur/ 'od tshur 'dus te dhīḥl thim pas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod cing sems can gyi don byas/ sdig sgrib sbyangs te tshur 'dus pas de yongs su gyur te/ bdag nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba'i tshul du 'dzin pa/

g.yon ut+pa la'i rtsa ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar bzung nas ut+pal snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bzhugs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon cung zad brkyangs pas seng ge nyal ba'i steng na pad zla la bzhugs pa/ dbu rgyan dang phyag gdub la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa ral pa'i thor cog dang ldan pa/ lang tsho dar la bab pa/ sku las 'od zer dmar ser rab tu 'phro bar bsgom/ de'i thugs kar bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bsam/ de'i lte bar ral gri sor bzhi pa yu ba la dhīḥs mtshan pa'i mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ de las 'od 'phros te/ rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' mdun du spyan drangs la yid kyis phyag dang mchod pa bya/ gsol ba gdab/ de nas dzaḥzhes brjod pas spyi bor byon/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas thim par bsam/ baṃ zhes brjod pas dbyer med du gyur/ hoḥzhes brjod pas dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par gyur/ de nas spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par zla ba'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga bsams te sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ de nas ral gri dhīḥdang bcas pa las 'od 'phros te/ rigs lngas spyi bo nas dbang bskur te chu lhag pa las snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas yang ral gri dhīḥdang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros te 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ tshur 'dus dhīḥl thim pas rang gi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal ba'i spro bsdu bsgom zhing*/ de'i sngags la klog pa'i tshul gyis bzlas pa bya zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥm me dī pam̐ mañdzu shrī mum̐ hrīḥpra dzñā dhā tu hrīḥdhīḥswā hā/ zhes so// thun mtshams su ye shes sems dpa' phyung la gsol ba btab ste gshegs su gsol/ nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing dge ba bsngo/

mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab par bya'o// de lta bu'i tshul gyis mi'i tshig gis bar ma chod pa'i bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bcu gcig sngon du song nas sgrub pa byed na/ tsan+dan/ yung ba/ a ka ru/ spang rgyan/ gla rtsi/ mtshal dkar/ a ru ra/ rgya skyegs/ shing mngar/ dbang po lag pa/ shu dag spang spos te dpa' bo bcu gnyis zhib par btags la sbrang rtsi dang ba dmar gyi 'o ma dang sbyar te ril bu brgya rtsa brgyad byas te/ rin po che'i snod du blugs te maṇ+ḍal ser po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su man+dzi la sogs pa'i steng du gzhag rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ger bsgoms te/ mdun gyi ril bu'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla ba bsam/ de'i steng du hrīḥsngon po las 'od 'phros te 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur te lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri bsnams pa/ g.yon ut+pa la bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bsgom/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa bzhugs par bsgom/ de nas ril bu la dmigs te sngags bzlas shing*/ thun mtshams su dbyangs can ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ril bu la thim par bsam/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis sngags khri phrag bcu gcig bzlas la/ de nas mngon rtogs tshang bar bsgoms te snga dro dang po la ril bu gcig gnyis pa la ril bu gnyis la sogs pa rim gyis 'phel bar/ nangs ma nyi shu rtsa gcig la rdzogs par bza'o// de lta bu'i sgrub pa lan cig byas pas shes rab 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs la/ lan gsum gyi bar du bsgrubs nas las 'phro med kyang nges par 'grub par 'gyur ro// 'phags pa 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge nyid kyis gsungs pa'i sgrub thabs bla ma brgyud pa las byung ba dang*/

'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mtshungs pa'i bla ma'i gsung la brten nas bla ma'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du bsdebs pa'o// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa 'jam dpal bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ de nas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsams te/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod par bya'o// de nas stong pa'i ngang las bam̐ dkar po gcig bsam/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho chen po gcig bsam/ de'i steng du pam̐ ljang gu gcig bsam/ de yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gcig bsam/ de'i steng du a dkar po yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i steng du rang gi sems yi ge a dkar po gcig tu bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'phags pa rnams mchod cing sems can gyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal nas tshur 'dus pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ut+pa la'i rtsa ba thugs kar mtheb srin gyis bzung nas snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ de'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ral pa'i zud phud lnga yod pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs pa/ dar dkar gyi stod g.yogs can/ sku las me dpung lta bu'i 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa sel ba/ gzhon nu'i cha lugs can du bsam/ mtsho de'i steng na me tog pad+ma dkar po mang po yod pa/ glang po che dkar po mang po mtsho de'i mtha' na chu bzhi'i 'thung bar bsams la/ sku de nyid la gsal bar dmigs te/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥzhes smra bcad byas la bsnyen pa 'bum phrag drug gam/ bco brgyad bskyal lo// de nas nyi ma'am zla ba gzas zin pa'i tshe dar dkar gyi khung du sran ma ma sha gril nas lce'i 'og tu bcug la sngar bzhin bsgom zhing bzlas shing*/

gza' las grol gyi bar du bzlas na myu gu'am me tog 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de nyid sos ma reg par mid na/ de'i mod la mtshungs pa med pa'i shes rab thob par 'gyur ro// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ saṃ k+ṣi pa ta shrī dzam+bha la sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ dpal dzam+bha la'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ dpal ldan dzam+bha la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas/ 'dir snying gar zla ba'i dbus su sa bon gnyis pa'i gsum pa/ mdog ser po stong pa'i lhas mnan pa/ zla ba phyed pas dbur brgyan pa/ de nyid rdzogs pa las dpal dzam+bha la sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas na bī dza pu ra ka dang*/ g.yon na rin po che'i char rab tu 'bebs bzhin pa'i ne'u le bsnams pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can/ zhabs gnyis kyis dung can dang*/ pad+ma can gyi mgo'i gter chen po dag mnan pa/ ut+pal sngon po'i phreng ba bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dzam+bha la'i skur bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o// rang gi khyim du yang rin po che la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i char 'beb bzhin pa/ rab tu 'jug pa'i bdag nyid bsam par bya'o// de nas phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings te/ gung mo dang dbus ma'i tshigs gsum pa bkug pa ni/ dzam+bha la'i phyag rgya zhes bya'o// oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā/ sngags 'dis rje btsun la chu khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad dbul bar byas te/ phyi nas mchod pa bya ste/ sngags bzla bar bya'o// de nas dngos grub ni sbyin bdag chen por 'gyur te the tshom med do// dpal dzam+bha la'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ bigh+nān ta ka sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das bgegs mthar byed la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po re zhig sgrub pa po stan bde ba la nye bar 'dug ste/ oṃ yig dmar po las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rang gi snying gar bsgom par bya'o// de'i steng du hūm̐ yig mthing nag bkod nas/

hūm̐ yig las skyes pa'i 'od zer gyis bgegs mthar byed dang*/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams la dmigs nas/ me tog la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod nas phyag btsal te/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa byas nas/ stong pa nyid bsgom par bya ste/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas so// de'i rjes su ram̐ yig dmar po las skyes pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ yig de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje hūm̐ yig gis byin gyis brlabs par bsgom par bya'o// hūm̐ yig de 'od zer gyis bskul nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rab tu gzhug pa sngon du 'gro bas/ de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las bgegs mthar byed bsgom par bya'o// zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ bdag nyid zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog mthing ga phyag g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje 'phyar bas 'jigs par byed pa/ dbu skra mar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las hūm̐ yig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdo rje'o// de las byung ba'i bgegs mthar byed spro ba dang bsdu ba'i tshul gyis chu skyes 'dab ma sna tshogs kyi steng du nyi ma la gnas pa bsgoms par bya'o// dam tshig la sogs pa'i cho ga sngon du 'gro bas so// 'di gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi'i thun mtshams su bsgom par bya'o// oṃ āḥbi gh+nān ta kṛ ta hūm̐/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā ba la sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ stobs po che'i sgrub thabs/ khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon du gsungs pa'i cho gas/ stong pa nyid kyi mthar pad+ma dkar po dang*/ nyi ma dang hūm̐ las byung ba'i stobs po che zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sku mdog thams cad dmar po/

dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil ba sbrul gyis bcings pa/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis kyis dbyug pa dkar po dang*/ rnga yab bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pa gnyis kyis phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang*/ zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od kyi phreng ba can/ 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan pa bsgom par bya'o// sngags bzla bar bya ste/ oṃ ma hā ba la swā hā/ zhes pa'o// stobs po che'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī bhū tā ḍā ma ra saṃ k+ṣip+ta sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ dpal 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ dpal ldan 'byung po 'dul byed la phyag 'tshal lo// tshangs pa brgya byin lus ngan sogs// myos 'joms rnam par mkhas pa yi// dpal ldan 'byung 'dul phyag 'tshal nas// de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya// mdor bsdus man ngag rnam dag pas// mdor bsdus 'dod phyir sbyar bar bya// gnod sbyin gnod sbyin mo sogs 'grub// bdag nyid ya mtshan skyes nas bris// dang por re zhig sngags pas/ thugs kar zla ba la khams gsum rnam par gsal ba'i 'od zer yang dag par 'khrigs pa/ lus la ram̐ yig dmar po'i sa bon rnam par bsam par bya'o// de nas dag pa'i lcags kyu'i rnam pas/ mdun du 'byung po 'dul byed gdan drangs nas/ bla na med pa'i mchod pa rnam pa bdun gyis mngon par mchod nas/ stong pa nyid bsgom par bya'o// de nas/ kun+da dang mtshungs dri med rnam rgyas mtshan mor byed pa yi// steng du dung 'dra hūm̐ yig bkod pa'i gnas dbus zla ba'i dkyil// shin tu 'bar bar byed pa ma lus yongs gyur yang dag las// sna tshogs pa yi chu skyes 'dab ma 'jam po lta bar bya// de nas de'i dbus su/ oṃ yig yongs gyur sman gyi dbang po'i steng*// hūm̐ yig snying po hūm̐ yig yongs gyur las// mthing nag 'bar ba'i rdo rje rnam par bsgom// de dag yongs gyur skad cig gis blta zhing*// mche gtsigs sku mdog mthing nag 'byung po rnams// skrag mdzad rang bzhin 'gro la nyer phan mdzad// khyab bya gcig chags rgyu yis 'phrog byed dang*// dbang phyug gzhon sogs bdud drag las gcig dpa'// zhal ni cung zad mche gtsigs shing*// khro bo 'bar zhing rngam par 'phro// dbu skra dmar ser gyen brdzes mthing*// na bza' sngon pos sku la brgyan// phyag g.yas na rdo rje bsnams pa/

g.yon na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thod pa lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ phyag g.yon na rtse gsum dang thod pa bsnams pa/ g.yon na ḍa ma ru bsnams pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyis dbur brgyan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ stag gi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs pa/ 'byung po'i dbang po gzhan las rgyal ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis dpal 'byung po 'dul byed kyi phyag rgya bcing ba bsgom par bya'o// de la phyag rgya 'di'o// ming med gnyis po bcing byas te// mdzub mo gnyis po bskum par bya// mthe'u chung gung mo de bzhin du// mtheb chen gyis ni mnan par bya// klu brgyad kyis ni nyer mdzes pa// de la stobs kyi rgyu sngon pos dbu skra bcings pa/ 'jog po dmar pos mgul rgyan byas pa/ dga' bo dang nye dga' bos rna rgyan byas pa/ 'di dag ni ser por gcig pa'o// mtha' yas dkar pos tshangs skud byas pa/ nor rgyas dkar pos rked rgyan byas pa/ phyag rgya'i phyag dag la rigs ldan dngul chu'i kha dog lta bu'o// phyag gzhan dag la/ de bzhin du dung skyong dkar po'o// zhabs gdub la pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po'o// mdog dmar por gcig pa'o// de bzhin du spyan gnyis dmar por gyur pa'i dpal 'byung po 'dul byed bsgom par bya'o// zhes so// khro dang bcas shing gcig tu 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ snying kha dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ mdzod spu dang*/ mgo bo rnams su bsrung ba'i don du phyag rgyas reg par bya'o// bsam gtan gyis ngal na sngags bzla bar bya'o// rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ khro bo'i bzlas pa'o// sngags ni/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa/ ces so// skyes bu dam pa yon tan don gnyer rnams kyi phyir// gang zhig gis kyang de bris ji ltar bdag gis gsal byas pa// dge ba gang des rnam par snang mdzad thob gyur nas// 'jig rten gsum po'i sdig pa mtha' dag 'joms par shog /dpal 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa rdzogs so//

༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po smre ba brtsegs pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ zhes pas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ thal kha de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa/ rab tu 'jigs pa/ bltas pa tsam gyis gdon thams cad skrag par byed pa/ grib dang mi gtsang ba rnams 'byer bar 'gyur ba/ gtum po chen po drag shul can/ shin tu rngam pa sku mdog dud ka zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ dbus mthing ga phyag g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na rdo rje/ g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub kyi rtse mo la pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ gnyis pa na zhags pa/ g.yas g.yon tha ma gnyis bsnol nas sdigs mdzub 'phyar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ gdan pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga bsam/ de las 'od 'phros te rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la yid kyis phyag dang mchod pa byas la gsol ba gdab/ dzaḥzhes brjod pas spyi bor byon/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas thim par gyur/ baṃ zhes brjod pas dbyer med du gyur/ hoḥzhes brjod pas dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de nas spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga bsam/ de nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ la sngags kyis bskor bar bsams te/ oṃ bhur ku ma hā pra ṇā ya/ bhu rtsi bhurki bi ma le/ uts+tshuṣ+ma kro dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

zhes bzlas pas sdig sgrib dang nyams grib mi gtsang ba thams cad chom chom bsregs par bsam/ thun mtshams su ye shes sems dpa' phyung la yid kyis phyag dang mchod pa bya/ bdag la tshul khrims 'chal ba dang*/ dam tshig nyams pa dang*/ mi gtsang ba'i nyams grib thams cad kyis mi gos par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la gshegs su gsol/ dge ba bsngo/ mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab par bya'o// khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa'i mngon rtogs rdzogs so// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ shukla tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa cha sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ khro bo gtum po chen po dkar po'i sgrub thabs/ khro bo gtum po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// stong pa nyid bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i gdan la sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i g.yas pa ral gri 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ pus mo g.yon pa sa la btsugs shing*/ g.yas pa tsog pur bzhugs pa'i thugs kar pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i lte bar hūm̐ la yig 'bru dgus yongs su bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das bsgoms la/ de'i mdun du gzhan yang de kho na lta bu zhal tshur bstan pa bsgom par bya'o// de nas sngags de dag shin tu 'bar bar blta'o// de'i rjes su sngags kyi phreng ba bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas thon te pha rol gyi zhal du zhugs shing*/ de'i lte ba nas byung ste rang gi lte bar zhugs/ yang rang gi zhal nas byung ste pha rol gyi zhal du zhugs par snga ma bzhin du bsgom zhing zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du bzlas nas snyan dngags mkhan du 'gyur ro// bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa'o// khro bo gtum po chen po mi g.yo ba dkar po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dā na shī las rang 'gyur du mdzad cing gsungs pa'o// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// jo bo mi g.yo ba sngon po bsgom par 'dod pas/

khrus dang gtsang sbra dang ldan pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ rang gi snying gar ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag gcig bsam/ de las 'od 'phros te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas mdun du bzhugs pa la/ yid kyis phyag bya/ mchod pa rnam pa lnga dbul/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bya/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ spyan drangs pa rnams gshegs par bsam/ de nas oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ zhes brjod pas stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag bsam/ de las 'od 'phros te/ 'phags pa mchod cing sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas tshur 'dus te hūm̐ la thim pas/ hūm̐ yongs su gyur te rang nyid 'phags pa mi g.yo ba sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba'i tshul du bsnams pa/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ pad nyi'i gdan la bgegs kyi rgyal po'i steng na zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pas bzhugs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa/ dbur skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom mo// de'i thugs kar ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag bsam/ de las 'od 'phros te ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas mdun du bzhugs pa la phyag dang mchod pa bya/ gsol ba gdab/ dzaḥzhes brjod pas spyi bor byon/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas thim par gyur/ baṃ zhes brjod pas dbyer med du gyur/ hoḥzhes brjod pas dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de nas spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga bsam/ yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros te rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs la mchod pa dbul te dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab/

rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas lha mo lnga byon te/ rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus kyi phyi nang gi dri ma dang sdig sgrib dag nas/ nang bdud rtsis gang ste spyi bor lud pa las rdo rje sems dpa' tshon gang ba gcig gis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags kyis bskor bar bsams te/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa ces bzla'o// thun mtshams su ye shes sems dpa' phyung la gsol ba btab ste gshegs su gsol/ dge ba bsngo/ mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab par bya'o// mi g.yo ba'i mngon par rtogs pa bla ma'i gsung bzhin bsdebs pa'o// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i dmigs pa skor gsum bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste skyabs 'gro lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad bsal ba'i ched du mi g.yo ba'i sgom bzlas bya/ bdag gis sngags 'di gnyis bzlas pas/ gnod byed thams cad 'jigs te mtho yul du 'khor yang mi nus pa yin snyam du sems kyis gzengs bstod/ de nas rang gi spyi bor ram̐ dmar ser gcig bsam/ de 'od du bzhu bas thig le ser po sran ma'i ga'u tsam du bsam/ thig le 'od du bzhu bas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sor bzhi par bsam/ de'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag gcig bzhengs nas bzhugs par bsam/ de las me khru gang tsam 'bar bas bdag gi thog ma med pa nas kyi las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad dang*/ gnod byed kyi gnod sems dang*/ gnod par byed pa'i nus mthu gsum bsregs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla'o// thun mtshams su yi ge la bsdu gshegs ni med/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis ni// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces bsngo bar bya'o// dmigs pa dang po yig 'bru la thim pa'o// gnyis pa ni yi ge la me 'bar ba yan chad sngar bzhin du bsgoms la/

de nas yi ge'i me thur la rang gi lus la 'bar bas lus dang sems kyi sdig sgrib bsregs nas/ sems kyi ngo bo khro bo mi g.yo ba sku mdog mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ yan lag sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pas bgegs kyi rgyal po'i gdan la bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i spyi bor nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yod pa las me 'bar bas sngar gyi bsreg bya gsum bsregs par bsam zhing bzlas pa bya/ mjug tu dge ba bsngo/ dmigs pa gnyis pa lha sku la gtad pa'o// gsum pa ni sems bskyed yan chad snga ma dang mthun no// de nas skad cig gis khro bo mi g.yo bar bsams te/ de'i thugs kar ram̐ bzhu ba las thig le ser po/ de zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag gcig bsam/ de las 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga na phar 'phros pas 'od kyi sna la khro chung mang po byung ste sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang bar bsam/ khro chung rnams sor bzhag la 'od zer hūm̐ la bsdu/ de nas hūm̐ las me 'bar bas rang khro bor gsal ba'i nang thams cad mes gang ba/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phar 'thon te/ phyi yang me 'bar ba'i dbus na gnas pa la sems gtad la bzlas pa bya'o// dmigs pa gsum pa srung ba'i 'khor lo la gtad pa'o// yi ge bcu pa'i bsnyen pa mang du byas pa'i rjes la sngags gnyis sbrel la bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa bdag la srungs shig srungs shig oṃ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa ma hā kro dha hūm̐/ tsha ti tsha ti s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐ phaṭa ces bzla'o// lus la bems po'am sha bkra'am 'gul ba la sogs pa'i sa der/ mgar ba'i sol mal du lcags bsregs pa bzhin du dmar lhang lhang 'dug par bsams la sngags bzla/ dus dus su sngags kyi mchil ma byug

phus gdab/ lce lkugs nas zlos ma shes pa byung na lce'i dkyil du rdo rje rgya gram gcig bsam/ lto na na zas za ba'i dus su kham dang po la sngags lan gnyis gsum bzlas la bza'o// gtor ma ni rin po che'i snod gtsang ma'i snod du khrag ma gtogs pa rtsam pa la gzhi blangs la 'byor tshad bsham/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams dang*/ yi dwags spyi dang*/ gnod byed bsam ngan can dang bcas pa la phul bas thams cad kyis mnyam zhing snyoms par thob par bsams shing*/ sbyin pa 'di yis bsod nams gang*// de yis yi dwags rjes 'gro zhing*// yi dwags bkres skom rab bcom nas// 'jigs pa kun las thar bar shog /ces brjod/ mjug dge ba bsngo zhing mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab par bya'o// rma bya shāka gzhon/ dpal ldan gro// sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ kun mkhyen mchims// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa rta mgrin bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bha wa shud+dha3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas thams cad stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po bsam/ de las 'od 'phros te/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas hrīḥl thim pas/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas na seng lding gi dbyug to bsnams pa/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi gtsug na rta mgo ljang gu skad 'byin pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pas bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad dang sdig sgrib thams cad sreg par byed par bsgom/

de nas thugs kar ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥlas 'od 'phros te rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas mdun na bzhugs pa la yid kyis phyag dang mchod pa bya/ gsol ba gdab/ dzaḥzhes brjod pas spyi bor byon/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas thim par gyur/ baṃ zhes brjod pas dbyer med du gyur/ hoḥzhes brjod pas dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de nas spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par zla ba'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga bsam/ de nas thugs ka'i hrīḥl sngags kyis bskor bar bsams te/ klog pa'i tshul du/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa ces bzlas la/ sdig sgrib dang bar chad ma lus pa thul thul bsregs par bsam zhing*/ bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gsum sngon du song bas rgyun du ci nus su bzlas/ mjug dge ba bsngos te mi dmigs par bya'o// bcom ldan 'das pad+ma'i mngon par rtogs pa bla ma'i gsung las byon pa ltar bsdebs pa'o// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sku khrus gsol bar 'dod pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten gyi spyan sngar mchod pa ci 'byor pa bsham/ gtor ma gsum bsham/ dri dang sbyar ba'i chu dang*/ chu gtsang ma dang*/ me long dang*/ ka ṭo ra la sogs pa'i snod bzang po dang*/ dar dkar ram ras sam snam bu dkar po'am/ de dag med na ser po la brten kyang btub ste de rnams sta gon bya'o// de nas sbyor ba sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje bsgoms te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du tshogs gsag pa dang sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir dkon mchog gi rten la sku khrus gsol snyam du bsam/ de nas cho ga bsdus pa'am rgyas pa gang yang rung bas/ 'dod pa'i lha sgrol ma'am gang yang rung bar bskyed/ de'i thugs kar sa bon gdan dang bcas pa bskyed/ de nas rten de rnams sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rang bzhin du bsams la spro bsdu bya ste/

de yang mchod rten yin na bum pa las 'od zer 'phros te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thugs kar phog pas de rnams kyi phrin las mchod rten gyi rnam pa che chung dang dbyibs la sogs pa de dag kho na 'dra ba dpag tu med pa spyan drangs la bstim/ sku yin na thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas lha de nyid kho na 'dra ba spyan drangs la bstim/ de yang lha nyung na re re nas bya/ mang na gtso bo la byas pa'i zhor la 'khor la yang mos pa bya ste/ chos kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan du gyur par bsam/ gsung rab yin na yig 'bru las 'od 'phros te spyan drangs la bstim/ de ltar spro bsdu lan lnga'am gsum tsam byas te/ rten thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa chos sku'i rang bzhin du lam gyis gyur par bsam/ yan lag bdun pa mdor bsdus shig byas la gsol ba gdab/ de nas rten thams cad la thun mong du me long gi nang du gzugs brnyan 'char bar byas la thog mar dri bzang gis sku khrus gsol/ de nas chu gtsang gis gsol/ de nas dar dkar gyis sku'i zil pa rnams phyi bar bsam/ de'i dus su sku khrus gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi tshigs su bcad pa la sogs pa ci rigs su gdon/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i bkra shis gdon/ sku khrus gsol bas rten de dag dwangs sing sing gyur pa dang*/ des sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib kyang dag par bsam/ de nas dngos su gsol bar 'dod pa rnams la dngos su sku khrus gsol bar bya/ gsol zin nas snod de phyogs ma nor bar byas la/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i steng du rten 'brel gyi yi ge rnams g.yas skor du dkar chem me bzhugs par bsam/ bdag nyid kyis rten 'brel bzlas pas kha nas yig 'bru dkar sher re phreng thag lta bu la 'khril nas song ste/ zla ba'i steng gi rten 'brel la thim pa dang de gnyis 'dus pa las bdud rtsi babs nas/
