'dul ba rnam pa bzhi gzigs nas// gang la ci 'dul ji bzhin du// de 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa slob dpon chen po a wa dhū tī pas mdzad pa rdzogs so//

༈ /da ni mgon po'i rtags kyi le'u ste/ de la/ phyi rtags nang rtags 'grub pa'i rtags// mi 'grub pa dang ldog pa'i rtags// rnam pa lnga ru shes par bya// de la/ 'tshubs ma shugs drag 'ong ba dang*// khang thog 'tsheg dang glu len dang*// a tsa ra dang bya nag dang*// dar nag thogs pa mang po dang*// rtag tu 'o dod 'bod pa rnams// phyi yi rtags su shes par bya// slob dpon 'ongs nas gtam smra dang*// chos 'chad lung ston gdugs 'bul dang*// ban+dha mtshan dang ldan ston pa// nang gi rtags su shes par bya// mgon po'i sku mdog gri gug dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang ca co 'don// dngos grub ster ba rmi ba dang*// stag dang seng ge mchong pa dang*// shel gyi mchod rten la bskor dang*// gter chen khyer dang 'phrad pa ni// grub pa'i rtags su shes par bya// mtshon cha'i char dang a tsa ra// 'khrugs dang rgol dang khro bo dang*// dud mos 'debs sogs sna tshogs ni// ldog rtags yin pas bsal bar bya// a ti sha yi chos 'di ni// ston pa spyan snga bya yul ba// mu sman

phyar ba sna thang pa gro mo che las byon// de gsung ji bzhin nam mkhas bsdebs// des btsun pa smon lam skyo ston tshul khrims la gnang pa'o// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ sar+b+ba kar+m+ma ā wa ra ṇa bi shud+dhe ka ra bi dhi/ bod skad du/ las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par 'thag par byed pa'i cho ga rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i zhal snga nas kyi bka'i gdams pas blo'i pad+mo kha bye ba/ snying rjes brgyud brlan zhing byang chub kyi sems brtan pas maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga bya/ snying brtse ba'i sems kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sems brtan por byas nas bsod nams kyi tshogs gsag par bya'o// oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmāḥṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twata/ ces pa'i tshig gi don rjes su dran pas ci tsam nus par ngal bso bar bya'o// dam bcas pa'i rjes su dran pa nyid las ma bskyod bzhin du sems nyid sgra'i rnam par gyur pa la sogs pas gzugs kyi sku mngon par 'byung bar 'gyur ro// sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ a ru ra dang bdud rtsi'i lhung bzed bsnams// sems dpa' gnyis po ser dang dkar ba ste// nyi ma zla ba gcig shos 'dud par byed// rnam par dag pa'i cho ga rdzogs par byas la gzhan thams cad snying po byang chub la bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi chos kyi sku rjes su dran pa brtan par bsgoms la/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal gyi gdams ngag gis/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye bhai ṣa dz+ye ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye rā dza sa muṅga te swā hā/ ji tsam nus pa bzlas la/ bcom ldan 'das mdun du bzhugs pa la mchod pa dang bstod pa byas te/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun de nyid kyi sngon gyi smon lam chen po bcu gnyis po lan gcig brjod par bya'o// de'i rjes la lam gyi shes rab dag pa'i las la 'bad par bya'o// thun mtshams su ji 'jigs la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin chen po bcu gnyis la gtor ma dbul bar bya'o// gzhan yang thun mtshams su bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyi mdo'i po ti klog pa dang kha ton du gdon par bya'o// gal te las kyi sgrib pa shin tu che na/

mdo de nyid nas gsungs pa'i cho ga rdzogs par bya'o// las kyi sgrib pa rnam par 'thag par byed pa'i cho ga slob dpon chen po mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang po lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gong du bshad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi lha 'di rnams kyi rjes gnang ni/ dang por gnas khang gang yin par dri bzang gis skyang nul byas pa'i sar/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad lha grangs dang mnyam pa byas pa'i khar me tog gi tshom bu dgod/ gtor ma yi dam spyi'i gtor ma/ chos skyong*/ gzhi bdag ste gsum bsham/ bum pa gnyis kha rgyan/ mgul chings bum rdzas dang bcas pa dang*/ rdo rje dril bu la sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams sta gon byas nas/ slob dpon gyi mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba bzhin/ tha dad kyi lha'i rnal 'byor bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ bzlas pa ci 'grub re/ de nas bum pa dang por lha thams cad kyi bskyed chog dang*/ bum pa gnyis par bgegs mthar byed bskyed la bzlas pa ci 'grub re dang*/ bdag mdun gnyis dang bum pa'i lha rnams la thun mong du mchod bstod grub nas gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma rnams yi dam gyi snying po rnams kyi mthar ba liṃ ta sbyar ba dang*/ chos skyong la gtor chog lugs bzhin nam/ a kā ros phul/ gzhi bdag la na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta'i sngags kyis bsngos la phrin las bcol/ de nas slob ma khrus dang gtsang sbra byas pas/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la gdan la 'khod nas/ slob dpon gyis sngon 'gro'i chos bshad/ slob mar rjes zlos byed du gzhug ste/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ skye rga na dang 'chi ba yis// chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba// srid pa'i mtsho las bdag sgrol mdzad// dga' chen ston pa khyod gcig pu// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig pa nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// tshig gis gsol ba lan gsum gdab/

sdom pa gzung ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum gyis sdom pa phog las bum gyi chus gtor/ swa bhā bas bsang sbyang*/ de nas/ slob ma la/ yi dam tha dad kyi mngon rtogs gsal 'debs su gzhug bla ma'i sku las 'od 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang rang bzhin chos sku'i ngang nas longs sku yi dam spyan drangs te slob ma la bstims pas/ slob ma'i lus lha skur mos par bya/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir du/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ lus kyi dri ma dag lha'i sku 'grub pa'i bag chags bzhag chu spyi gtsug tu lud pas/ de bzhin gshegs pas dbur brgyan par gyur/ ces sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// de nas bla ma'i zhal nas sngags phreng 'thon/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ rang bzhin gyi sngags phreng dang lhan cig tu slob ma'i khar zhugs/ ngag la nus pa bzhag par mos la/ lha tha dad kyi sngags kyi rjes zlos lan bdun nam gsum bya/ brten byed bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas ngag gi dri ma dag lha'i gsung 'grub pa'i bag chags bzhag chu spyi gtsug tu lud pas pad+ma'i rigs kyi lhas dbur brgyan par gyur/ ces gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas yang bla mas snod bcud kyi yon tan thams cad dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs te slob ma la bstims pas/ slob ma 'od phung du gyur/ mthar stong nyid kyi don bshad/ de nyid bsgom du gzhug zab gsal gnyis med kyi nga rgyal bskyed/ brtan byed bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas/ sems kyi dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas rdo rje'i rigs kyi lhas dbur brgyan pa la mchod/ mchod pa rnams rjes gnang gsum ga la bya/ mthar bkra shis brjod/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ phyag btsal/ bka' drin che zhes bya/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo/ slar gtang rag gi phyag mchod/ bstod pa rnams bya/ rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i gsung bzhin dge slong nam mkha' grags kyis bsdebs pa'o//

༈ /na mo gu ru/ sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas te/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po las 'od 'phros pas lus sbyangs nas/ rang nyid sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po sku mdog sngon po/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ klu dang sems can thams cad ngan 'gro las thar bar byed pa'i chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ g.yon du dgra bcom pa du ma/ mdun du klu'i tshogs thal mo sbyar ba du ma bsam/ ye shes pa gzhug sngags ni/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ta thā ga to/ bha ga wān/ nā ga rā dze/ shwa ra a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ zhes 'bum phrag bzla/ nad thams cad myong bar nges pa'i las thams cad 'dzad par 'gyur ro// rdzogs rim ni rim gyis bsdus te stong par bsgom/ thun mtshams su klu dbang rgyal po'i mtshan nyer gcig brjod/ gtor ma gsum byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das/ 'jig rten skyong ba/ klu dbang dang gsum la a kā ro la sogs pas sbyin no// 'di'i bris sku yod pa'i sar klu nad 'byung mi srid/ 'di mdo rtog gi tshogs rgyud/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu bzang po'i rgyud nas slob dpon klu sgrub kyis phyung nas/ jo bos bsnams nas byon no// mtshan 'dzin pa la yon tan dpag med bshad do// bcom ldan ral gris bkod pa rdzogs so// //oṃ swa sti/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan yongs 'du'i ljon// rab rgyas 'gro kun thar mchog 'bras bzang la// spyod phyir lhun grub yang rtse'i dben tshal du// chos sbyin 'dzad med dal 'gro'i rgyun 'di spel// 'di'ang blo gter dbang pos so// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/
skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
